title: Synthesis of 1,2,4-triazole and 1,3,4-oxadiazole derivatives as inhibitors for STAT3 enzymes of breast cancer.
authors: Fawzy, Sherif M; Loksha, Yasser M; El-Sadek, Mohamed; Ibrahim, Samy M; Beshay, Botros Y; Shamaa, Marium M; Kothayer, Hend
one_liner_zh: 该文合成三唑/噁二唑类小分子抑制剂靶向STAT3酶并用于乳腺癌，虽含分子建模但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Disubstituted five-membered heterocycles (1,2,4-triazole and 1,3,4 oxadiazole) were synthesized and investigated as inhibitors for signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) enzyme of breast cancer. 3-(Benzylthio)-5-(4-chlorobenzyl)-4H-1,2,4-triazol-4-amine (12d) was found to be the most active among the synthesized compounds with a half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC(50) ) value of 1.5 microM on MCF7 cells and was found to show a great inhibitory effect on the STAT3 enzyme. Compounds 9a,b,d,e,f, 11, and 12a,b,f,e show IC(50) values in the range of 3-12 microM for the MCF7 cell line. Molecular modeling was used to investigate the biological results of the synthesized compounds.
abstract_zh: 合成了双取代五元杂环化合物（1,2,4-三唑和1,3,4-噁二唑），并研究了它们作为乳腺癌信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）酶的抑制剂。在合成的化合物中，3-(苄硫基)-5-(4-氯苄基)-4H-1,2,4-三唑-4-胺（12d）被发现活性最高，其对MCF7细胞的半数抑制浓度（IC(50)）值为1.5微摩尔，并对STAT3酶显示出显著的抑制效果。化合物9a,b,d,e,f、11和12a,b,f,e对MCF7细胞系的IC(50)值在3-12微摩尔范围内。采用分子建模方法研究了合成化合物的生物学结果。
